description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

Freudenberg Performance Materials is part of the Freudenberg Group and a leading global supplier of innovative technical textiles for a broad range of markets: From apparel, automotive, building materials, civil engineering, energy, filter media, healthcare and to building interiors and more. Join our team and shape the future of innovation with us! Discover our world at www.freudenberg-pm.com.

You support our team as Procurement Specialist with German

Responsibilities

  • Independent and self-responsible procurement of goods and services based on purchase requisitions, taking into account compliance requirements and existing corporate and purchasing guidelines;
  • Independent coordination of all order relevant parameters with the requisitioner as well as clarification of details with suppliers;
  • Monitoring and maintenance of purchasing data in existing systems and purchasing (price) lists;
  • Identification, communication, and onboarding of new suppliers as part of supplier management;
  • Steering and monitoring of the operational ordering process (conversion of purchase requisitions into purchase orders) and processing of order confirmations;
  • Clarification of commercial and technical questions arising from suppliers and internal stakeholders;
  • Clarification of deviations in payment terms (purchase order / master data / invoice) in individual cases.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business Administration, or a comparable field;
  • Good German and English language skills;
  • Professional experience in purchasing is desirable;
  • General understanding of purchasing processes is desirable;
  • General understanding of ERP systems is desirable; SAP knowledge is an advantage;
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured working approach and high attention to detail;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; proactive communication with internal and external stakeholders;
  • Interest in interdisciplinary and international teamwork;
  • High service orientation and strong team spirit;
  • High flexibility with effective time and self-management skills;
  • High reliability, resilience and friendliness.

Career changers and entry-level candidates are explicitly encouraged to apply. We offer a comprehensive on-boarding program to equip you with the required expertise and integrate you seamlessly into our professional procurement team!

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
